summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of a major shareholder notification under Section 38 of the Danish Capital Markets Act, effectively a Schedule 13D/G-equivalent ownership disclosure for a non-US issuer. BW Altor Pte. Ltd. tendered 109,352,091 Cadeler shares (about 28.33% of capital and votes) into the Cadeler plc share exchange offer tied to the group's Denmark-to-UK redomiciliation, receiving 109,352,090 Cadeler plc shares. Post-settlement it holds 30.77% of Cadeler plc after 7.94% of holders failed to tender. Watch non-tender acceptance, residual minority and redomiciliation risk.
